purpose: Independent evaluation of classroom-ready teacher-guide artifacts. This rubric is not owned or editable by the Content Worker runtime.

dimensions.description: Displayed curriculum outcomes and content are faithful to authoritative curriculum evidence.
Scientific/factual explanations, terminology, examples, equations and expected results are correct.
Every claimed outcome has explanation, learner experience, teacher check and observable learner evidence.
Teaching progresses coherently from prerequisites through explanation, activity, checking and consolidation.
A teacher can execute the lesson with explicit preparation, resources, prompts, timing/flow and expected outcomes.
Assessment samples intended outcomes and includes usable answer/marking guidance.
Practical work is executable, safe, correctly controlled and includes observations, interpretation and cleanup where relevant.
Material claims are traceable to approved evidence; uncertainty is declared rather than invented.
Examples/resources fit Kenyan classrooms without fabricating local claims or assuming unrealistic equipment.
The guide provides meaningful support/extension and inclusive access rather than generic labels.
The guide is navigable, unambiguous and operational rather than a content summary.

severity.critical: Material correctness/safety/curriculum defect requiring correction before editorial acceptance.
severity.major: Substantial teaching-quality defect; artifact is not classroom-ready.
severity.minor: Localized quality/usability weakness that does not invalidate the artifact.
